title: Write features/daw/import_markers.feature and the domain warp_markers.feature (red)
description:
## Intent
Specs first for M5.

## Scope
- `features/daw/import_markers.feature`: all scenarios of the four M5 stories; `features/daw/STEPS.md` rows.
- `features/data/domain/warp_markers.feature`: the library operation (replace one person's warp markers for a sample: idempotent; leaves other markers, clips and other people's warp markers alone), in the house style of `features/data/domain/markup_merge.feature`, run by the existing domain runners.
- Broken import fixtures (wrong length, out of order, beyond the end, warp off, unknown version).

## Verify
`safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-cli --test daw_cli` and the domain runner fail on the new scenarios for the right reason.

---
**Toolchain:** every Bash call starts with `export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2`; run builds and tests under the watchdog: `safe-run.sh -- <command>` (6 GB / 20 min cap; do not edit it). At most two Rust-building agents at once.
**Protocol:** specs first (write the scenario, watch it fail, then code); keep a running log with `kbs comment` (decisions, problems, attempts, outcomes); paste the tail of **Verify** before asking for review; never commit, push or close (the reviewer does, after re-running Verify). Never write the DAW's brand name anywhere.
